correctness.rationale: The specified GP(8,3) graph has 16 vertices and 24 edges; every nonface of the edge-subset complex contains a three-edge matching. An independently written exhaustive enumerator generated precisely 1,096 forbidden triples, 3,149 augmented faces, f=(24,276,928,1224,600,96), and the 1,552 pairs from the declared increasing-edge sequential matching. It independently topologically sorted all 11,832 augmented and 11,808 ordinary directed cover relations, with no cycle and exactly one remaining ordinary critical 0-cell and 45 ordinary critical 3-cells. Standard integral discrete-Morse theory gives a CW complex with precisely those cells: attaching 3-cells to the point 2-skeleton yields wedge of 45 S^3. Completeness is for this 24-edge graph only, not a sampled extrapolation.
